scope: Actual local invariant-z slab mode pulse with reference-normalized total cross-section flux. No finite-height 3D ports, modal S-parameters, commercial match or convergence certification.
runtime: Existing WSL managed runtime; CPU and explicit NVIDIA CUDA FDTD; local CPU callback prepares the Tidy3D numerical mode with no account or cloud calls.
implementation_version_note: Installed FDTDX 0.6.2 source was inspected; stable online documentation may describe newer releases. Continuous checks call the same installed forward Yee update without resetting fields, PML state or DFT accumulators.

reproduction.supported_cases: Write the selected exact case config below to a new JSON file, then run .venv/bin/python scripts/run_simulation.py CONFIG.json --output NEW_DIRECTORY. The launcher resolves the configured solver interpreter and requires a fresh output directory.
reproduction.negative_case: gpu-insufficient-ringdown deliberately bypasses the GUI minimum time cap: in a fresh configured FDTDX interpreter process call backend.adapters.fdtdx_ports_adapter.run(config, Path(NEW_DIRECTORY)). It is not a supported GUI configuration.
reproduction.historical_case: gpu-gap-full-cap-prototype used the same pulse/material/monitor equations but the earlier full-cap loop. Its raw saved monitor data are retained; the current adapter stops on measured criteria. A documented raw-reflection sign-only postprocessing correction was applied before recording its spectrum hash.

comparisons.interpretation: Execution-target consistency, not a physical accuracy certificate.
Grid sensitivity; no tuned parameters or convergence threshold.
Measured early stopping versus earlier full-cap solve with identical source and physical parameters.

gpu_unavailable_negative_check.observed_adapter_error: Requested gpu initialization failed; CPU fallback is disabled

math_tests.scope: Synthetic E/H flux and coherent subtraction, both transverse polarizations, signed/unclipped ratios, invalid bins, and exclusion of future zero energy-detector slots. These fixtures do not validate solver physics.

limitations: No rigorous numerical error bound: only one FDTDX grid refinement and a longer-time diagnostic are included.
No FDTDX PML/domain sensitivity suite in this increment.
Mode profile solved only at centre frequency; pulse source implementations differ between solvers.
Flux is total through finite apertures, not mode-resolved S-parameters; 1-R-T includes lateral radiation and numerical/monitor effects.
Float32 JAX fields and complex phasor accumulators; host stability differences calculated in complex128.
Earlier fixed-cap CPU trial was manually stopped after exceeding200s; it is not included as a completed solve.
Wall times depend on host/GPU load; they are observed run durations, not performance promises.
